## ✅ Step 4 checked — the agent's PR is linked!

## Step 5: Review against acceptance criteria

Open your PR (#{{pr}}) and leave **at least one inline review comment** on a specific file/line, tied to one of your acceptance criteria from the spec issue — for example, asking for an accessible label on the favorite toggle, or empty-state copy for an empty favorites page.

Review like the spec is the source of truth: check each acceptance criterion, and comment on the gaps.

The bot watches for a review comment on PR #{{pr}} and will automatically advance you to Step 6 once it sees one.
